definition: Alsahan-Harris syndrome (ALHAS) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by bi-allelic variants in TBC1D32, characterized by a severe prenatal phenotype and life-limiting congenital anomalies including midline craniofacial defects and central nervous system malformations.

source.title: Entry - #621307 - ALSAHAN-HARRIS SYNDROME; ALHAS
source.quote: Alsahan-Harris syndrome (ALHAS) is an autosomal recessive severe prenatal phenotype associated with life-limiting congenital anomalies.
